acceptanceCriteria: Source quality stages the typed source Runtime and fixed legacy Runtime under the exact target paths expected by the canonical release gates, and verifies both are executable.
Normal release validates the immutable remote annotated tag against typed sourceRevision and writes that source revision into the manifest while independently binding headRevision to GITHUB_SHA.

No product Runtime, gate manifest, tag, Release, provider resource, or merge is changed by this Work Item.
